text:
Ana: Quick scheduling question — our Wed onsite panel for candidate C-42 is currently 11:00–12:30 PT. Candidate requested live ASL interpreter; that adds ~15m buffer. Can the panel shift to 11:15–1:00 or should we do 11:15–12:45 + 15m debrief? Need a volunteer to take debrief notes.

Samir: 11:15 works for me, but I have a hard stop at 12:30. Could do 11:15–12:45 instead if Maya can extend.

Priya: We can update the invite and book the interpreter if panel agrees. Does the rubric change for accessibility accommodations (extra time for answers)? We usually keep 45m interview + 15m debrief.

Maya: I can stretch to 12:45. Recommend 11:15–12:45 with 15m debrief after — total 90m with interpreter included. Will Jordan be able to take debrief notes? @Jordan

Jordan: I can scribe, yes. Do you want the usual scoring weights (tech/communication/ownership) or a tweak given accommodations?

Ana: Keep weights the same. Please just add a top-line note in the debrief doc that the candidate used an interpreter so answers may take slightly longer.

Priya: I'll update the calendar once final. Draft invite copy below — confirm and I'll book the interpreter.

Priya: ```
Calendar invite copy:
Subject: Onsite: C-42 — Systems Engineer
Time: Wed 11:15–12:45 PT
Location: SF HQ / Zoom (interpreter on Zoom)
Notes: Interpreter booked. Please start on time. Debrief after interview (12:45–13:00). Rubric: tech 50, comms 30, ownership 20. Scribe: Jordan.
```

Samir: :+1: confirmed.

Maya: Confirmed. Also quick ask — can we pin the candidate's latest take-home artifacts to the Drive folder? I can't find the updated submission.

Ana: Link added: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/abc123 (candidate_C42) — check access and ping if blocked.

Jordan: Got access. I'll prep the debrief doc template and add a line about interpreter modality + whether any clarifying questions were needed.

DevEx Bot: Reminder: interpreter booking expires in 48h if not confirmed. /remind #people-ops in 36h "Confirm interpreter booking for C-42"

Priya: Thanks — I'll book once everyone gives final :thumbsup:.

Samir: :thumbsup:

Maya: :thumbsup:

Ana: Final: moving invite now. Scribe = Jordan. Thanks team!
